notes.text: Hyman explicitly says ONE OF FIVE SONS of R' Yose ben Halafta; the numeral and relationship are preserved as his statement. Both the heading ר' אבטילס and the father's abbreviated title remain R' because no exact named-edition primary passage is supplied here to support expanding either title. Shabbat118b is the conventional reading of the supplied קיח: locator, not a newly inspected printed page or independently established genealogy. The original note and earlier full Rabbi English remain archived; this qualification does not retire that note or establish printing history.
